title: Reefer Cargo Services: Customer Remittances Against Service Charges
content:
The charges due on a Reefer Cargo Services container are kept as one running amount per service. Inspection, plug-in, special service, monitoring, setting change, late request and cancellation fees increase it; remittances, goodwill waivers and excursion credits reduce it. This page covers how a remittance from the customer is entered against that amount.

## Clause

Each remittance is set against a single service. It is entered with the remittance reference exactly as the customer quotes it and with the amount remitted, except that the amount entered may not exceed the charges due on that service at the time. Where the customer has sent more than is due, only the amount due is entered; the surplus is not booked and is returned by finance. On any one service, a given remittance reference is entered only once.

## Amount entered

The amount entered is the smaller of the sum remitted and the charges due on the service.

| Sum remitted compared with the charges due | Amount entered | What remains |
|---|---|---|
| less than the charges due | the whole sum remitted | the rest of the charges stays due |
| equal to the charges due | the whole sum remitted | nothing due |
| more than the charges due | the charges due | the surplus is returned by finance, not booked |

## Worked examples (hypothetical amounts)

- Charges due 420.00, remittance 500.00: 420.00 is entered and the 80.00 surplus is returned by finance.
- Charges due 420.00, remittance 300.00: 300.00 is entered and 120.00 stays due.
- A remittance reference already entered on a service is quoted again for that service: it is not entered a second time.
- The same reference quoted for a different service is judged on that other service; the once-only rule applies service by service.

## Points of judgement

- The reference is copied exactly as quoted, without correction or reformatting.
- A single remittance is not spread over several services by this rule.
